privacy.pageDescription: Draft privacy policy for Manuela Bermúdez, real estate advisor.

header.title: Privacy policy
header.description: Draft under review. It describes how personal data is handled on this site.

draft.title: Draft pending legal review
draft.text: This text is a working draft and is not yet a final privacy policy. Before publishing it, a person with legal training must review it and complete the missing details.

responsible.title: Data controller
responsible.text: Manuela Bermúdez, real estate advisor. You can write to {{email}} or call {{phone}}.

data.title: Data collected
data.text: Contact forms request your name, email, phone, and message. Creating an account requests your name, ID number, date of birth, email, role, and language. Publishing a property stores the property details and the images you choose to upload.

purpose.title: How it is used
purpose.text: Data is used to answer inquiries, manage accounts, publish properties, record closings, and send the site's operational emails.

testimonials.title: Testimonials
testimonials.text: Testimonials are published with the name and profession you provide. Your email and linked account are not shown: they are stored in a private collection accessible only to administration. Every testimonial requires approval before publication.

storage.title: Storage and services
storage.text: The site uses Firebase (Google) for authentication, database, and image storage. The browser stores the selected language and the active session. Legal review must confirm the applicable providers and transfers.

rights.title: Rights
rights.text: You can request access, correction, or deletion of your data by writing to {{email}}. Requests will be handled through the same channel.

retention.title: Retention
retention.text: Data is kept while the account is active or while it is needed for the purposes described. Final retention periods are pending legal review.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: For questions about this draft or your data, write to {{email}}.
